At Sculptsoft, we partnered with the client to develop an advanced Virtual Body Measurement Tool tailored for their eCommerce platform. Our Solutions - Virtual Body Measurement Tool
Sculptsoft designed and implemented an advanced Virtual Body Measurement Tool to address these challenges. This innovative solution was seamlessly integrated into the client’s eCommerce platform.

Interactive Body Scan Process: The Virtual Body Measurement Tool guided users through a simple and engaging process to capture accurate body measurements:
- Scan the QR Code
 Customers scanned a QR code on the eCommerce site using their smartphone.
- Answer Basic Questions
 Users provided information about their height and gender to initiate the process.
- Capture Two Photos
 Customers took two full-body photos – one from the front and another from the side. These photos ensured comprehensive measurement data.
- AI-Based Calculation
 The tool used AI to analyze the photos, calculate precise body measurements, and cross-reference them with the product’s size chart.
- Receive Size Recommendation
 After the scan, the recommended size was displayed directly on the eCommerce platform, allowing customers to proceed with confidence.

Customer engagement on the client's eCommerce platform grew by 50% , resulting in a more interactive and satisfying shopping experience.
